description:
lib/kernel.fz declares all 68 extern defps in one block at the top of the module, far from the defs that call them. The Elixir idiom is to put a def's private helpers directly after it. Move each extern defp to sit right after the def (or operator clause family) that uses it; the four _bb ordering externs sit after their operator, beside the commented-out binary clause they serve.

This is a pure reordering: the set of declarations and every body are unchanged.
title: Kernel: each extern defp sits directly after the def that uses it
